summary: John's 5th-great-grand-aunt; wife of Col. George P. Ransom.
bio:
Elizabeth Lamoreaux (30 Sep 1776 - 27 Aug 1859) married Col. George Palmer Ransom in 1794; 13 children. Her children, incl. Chester Ransom (1808-1893), are John's 1st cousins 7x removed.

FamilySearch gives Elizabeth's birth as 18 Oct 1776 at Monroe, Orange Co., NY, against 30 Sep 1776 on the site, and her marriage to George Palmer Ransom at Plymouth on 9 Jan 1794. It cites Historical Society of Pennsylvania baptism and marriage records and finds her in his household in 1850 ([R4-S1]).
